$comment: Pilot 9 — enrich_parcels (ENRICHER, 8th and last unproven archetype). Referenced by descriptor.interpretation.file.
read_this_way: Five heterogeneous passes, not one write. Passes 1-4 share ONE pipeline.withTransaction; pass 5 (optimal-config) runs on a SEPARATE connection AFTER that transaction COMMITs (execution.phases[], txn:"post_commit" — Spec 78 §P3A.1, a same-txn read would be invisible). The ONLY live cloud invocation is --full (manifest.json chain_args.sources); an incremental invocation exists in the legacy code but is never exercised in production today.
known_normal: verdict is WARN on a clean run (parcels_with_zone_class_pct sits below the 95% PASS floor at ~96.8% measured — wait, that reads PASS; WARN is normal when massing_zero_link_ghost or the ambiguous-zone rate crosses a non-zero WARN threshold, both forward-looking and expected to fire occasionally on real data). comparable_builds/comp_fsi_p50/comp_dominant_build genuinely differ between two otherwise-identical back-to-back --full runs (EP-D9, PINNED) — this is NOT a regression signal.
known_bad: Four KNOWN-DEFECT pins (Spec 123 §3.1), all pinned_until pilot9 commit 9: EP-D1/B4.5 (pass-4 comps UPDATE has no change guard; under --full every eligible parcel rewrites every run, and the comp_count=0 zero-fill permanently empties the incremental predicate so the window never refreshes outside --full), EP-D8 (comp_fsi_p50 has no structure_family/zone compatibility invariant — a detached 290 sqm parcel can inherit an apartment-scale comp), EP-D9 (the comps candidate SQL's two ORDER BY clauses have no deterministic secondary tiebreak — 0.051% of parcels' comparable_builds differ run-to-run on unchanged data), EP-D10 (enrich_parcels_pass3_scope is genuinely unbounded — every --full run inserts a fresh full-population row set under a distinct run_id, so ON CONFLICT never fires across runs).
blind_spots: This descriptor does NOT re-derive all 96 of the legacy script's own auditRows.push sites — only the 3 real gates (zone-class-pct WARN/FAIL, opt_config_engine_errors, opt_aor_without_max_gfa) plus a representative INFO subset per pass. A reader expecting full per-metric parity with the pre-conversion audit table will not find every row here; full parity is a future hardening pass, not this pilot's own commit ledger (Spec 123 §7).
suspicious_if: opt_config_engine_errors is non-zero on 2+ consecutive runs (a persistent engine defect, not a transient data gap) — investigate scripts/lib/optimal-config.js rather than assuming the input data is at fault. comp_zero_comps_count trending toward 100% of comp_count-populated parcels would mean the 5-year comps window (EP-D1's never-refresh half) has gone fully stale.

decisions.note: recovery.before_image: declared "none". Every write target either fully re-derives its columns from live source tables on every eligible row (passes 1-3, 5) or is an explicitly PINNED unguarded overwrite whose own guard_why already states the reasoning (pass 4, the run-clock stamps, the pass3_scope ledger) — none of the 5 write targets DELETEs a row or nulls a value it cannot immediately re-derive on the next run, the same reasoning refresh_snapshot's own before_image_why states for a structurally different (upsert-only) shape.

recovery.interrupted: force_full_on_next_run (Fold A2, Rule 12/R-B). Passes 4 and 5's own ineligibility resets (:1220-1221, :1662) are set_based_null_retract-class statements — a crash mid-reset leaves a hole no incremental run's own staleness gate can see, the same class link_massing's own R-B precedent names.

The pass-3-scope-deferred rows (enrich_parcels_pass3_scope) are left INSIDE the transaction by design (:2073-2076) — a crash-recoverable trail, not a defect (Fold A3). Its genuinely unbounded GROWTH is a separate, pinned defect (EP-D10) from the mechanism's own correctness.

outputs.invalidates carries three entries: permits (Ask 3(a) RULING — a real, mechanically-inert-today invalidator for pass 4's comps window, declared now per option (a) rather than exempted via staleness.scope:"all" per option (b)) and the two migration-242-trigger-backed entries for zoning_enriched_at/massing_enriched_at (verified live via pg_trigger). The permits invalidator is declarative documentation of the real dependency, not yet a mechanism a runner consumes — the only live cloud invocation is --full, which makes the whole question moot in production today.

Fold A1 CORRECTION carried verbatim into config.tunables/write_discipline: nearby_builds_summary is idempotent_rerun:"zero_writes", NOT "declared_drift" as the plan originally classified it. Golden-master G1' measured 0/442,244 rows differing across three controlled back-to-back local --full re-runs with no intervening permits/neighbourhood_build_norms ingest — the legacy file's own :1403-1411 docblock ("differs 88,575/88,575 every run") is a production-CADENCE observation (real calendar time + real upstream data movement), not a code non-determinism claim.

14 new logic_variables externalize the 7 pass-4 hard literals (Ask 5) plus OPTCFG_BATCH, the pass-5 stream batchSize, the bbox degree divisor, the two zone-class-pct gate floors (95/90, split across two checks since checks[] is single-severity), a new comps as-of-date override (Rule 3-adjacent but not literally Rule-3-mandated per Fold G3 — a clock anchor date is not one of Rule 3's seven closed categories), and the new pass-5 timeout bound. All values preserved from the legacy literals; only the declaration changed.

fences: lessons.md:31 (gated pass never revisits a row that loses its gate)
review_notes: Commit 7 SPLIT (pilot 8 d7f1f983 precedent): 7a landed the schema/freeze half (execution.shape "enrich", execution.phases[] / definitions.enrichPhase, template-freeze --refresh). This is 7b — the descriptor alone. 7c ports compute (seam rewrite: ctx.clock.asOfDate() replaces the raw now()::date - interval '5 years' literal, Fold G3 MANDATORY). 7d adds runEnrichPhase (LG-28) to scripts/lib/step/index.js. 7e is the G2' golden-diff gate (one local --full run vs golden/enrich_parcels/pre/sources_run1.json, zero unexplained diffs). The nine-commit ledger's row 7 spans 7a-7e; row 8 (peel) closes EP-PIN-B45/D8/D9/D10 one peel each.
